suites.primary_role: Agent behavior evidence, decision traceability, governed explanations, handoff context, trust intelligence summaries, and client demo/readiness packaging.
suites.authority_posture: Evidence, explanation, readiness, and packaging. No runtime mutation or enforcement authority by default.

suites.primary_role: SOC 2-aligned evidence packages, audit workspace, control traceability, evidence registers, export manifests, and auditor-facing summaries.
suites.authority_posture: Evidence recording, mapping, traceability, packaging, and presentation. No runtime enforcement authority by default.

suites.primary_role: Runtime assurance doctrine, enforcement-readiness pathways, control-point routing, SENTINEL-backed decision posture, and production-boundary clarity.
suites.authority_posture: Runtime-impacting authority only when explicitly granted by doctrine, module authority matrix, deployment phase, and SENTINEL control-point rule.

suites.primary_role: Risk posture narratives, authority overlap analysis, control gap summaries, trust scoring context, and customer-safe risk intelligence.
suites.authority_posture: Analyze, score, explain, and summarize. No runtime mutation, authorization, or enforcement authority by default.

non_suite_substrates.name: Shared Trust Fabric
non_suite_substrates.role: Shared doctrine, registries, schemas, contracts, taxonomy, evidence metadata, and traceability substrate used by all suites.

non_suite_substrates.name: Doctrine Control Plane
non_suite_substrates.role: This repository. It defines the portfolio doctrine and contract source of truth.

frozen_rules: Only four customer-offerable suites are frozen in the baseline.
Shared Trust Fabric is not a fifth customer-offerable suite.
Suite membership does not create authority.
SENTINEL remains canonical for runtime-impacting control decisions.
